Text typed into the composer was never sent; never Enter on /clear or /compact. The path is scrubbed to ~/proj (column-preserving padding). Composer: a rounded box, `│ > <input> │` (continuation rows `│   <input> │`; kimi wraps long input by words), directly under the welcome box and notices, a footer row below it (model, folder, branch, a rotating tip; `plan` first when started with --plan; `context: 0% (0/256k)` under it). The cursor is an inverse cell in the composer row. A command typed whole shows a grey (136,136,136) hint after it (`/compact  <instruction>`): not input; typed text is the default colour, a command is bold blue. The slash menu is a panel BELOW the composer (no top border of its own: its first row follows the box's bottom border): rows `│   → name  description │` (highlighted) or `│     name  description │`, a skill or an alias in the list (`new (clear)`: /clear is /new's alias; `settings (config)`), long descriptions wrap onto rows indented the same, `(n/m)` last; it scrolls. Tab on `/cl` writes the canonical `/new` into the box (no run). The first start in a folder asks `Trust this folder?` (frame-trust-dialog: a full-width rule above and below, `↑↓ navigate · Enter select · Esc exit`, Trust / Don't trust; Esc or Don't trust exits kimi): there is no composer then.
